From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@acmeinfra.com>, Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@acmeinfra.com>

Subject: Final rollout coordination & cutover owners — schedule confirmation

Hi Anita / Tom —

Thanks again for working through the final checklist with us. We want to lock the 60-minute go/no-go + cutover owners call to finalize the launch playbook, confirm fallback policies, and verify who owns each step during the 48-hour window. Proposed agenda (high level):

- Introductions & roles (5m)
- Final cutover runbook review (15m)
- Fallback/rollback decision tree + SLA expectations (15m)
- Owner assignments & contact handoff (10m)
- Open items / next steps (15m)

Can we please confirm a 60-minute slot on either:
- Tue, Oct 13 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue, Oct 13 — 15:00–16:00 PT
- Wed, Oct 14 — 09:00–10:00 PT

I've attached the current cutover_runbook_v1.pdf and a short MOP checklist (mop-checklist.xlsx) for pre-read. Marcus (SE) and Ethan (infra lead) will cover the technical steps; Monica will handle procurement/contract items on the call.

If any of those times don't work, please propose two alternatives and we'll aim to accommodate.

Thanks,

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: cutover_runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB); mop-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the materials and the clear agenda. We're aligned on the topics — the only snag is our security lead is out Tues afternoon. Two notes from our side:

1) Can we move to Wed, Oct 14 09:00–10:00 PT? That works for engineering + security.
2) Procurement needs a short (20m) slot to confirm billing/PO timing; they prefer to join at the tail end or we can run a separate quick sync the next day.

If Wed morning is free for you and your team, that would be ideal. Also, would you include the fallback contact matrix in the runbook before the call (who owns immediate rollback vs extended rollback)? I can circulate to security for a quick review prior to Wed.

Best,
Anita
